title: Positive Length of a Halting Run
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register program, let $x$ be an input, and start from any configuration with an active state and arbitrary register values. If every choice sequence of length $N$ leads to a halted state, then $N$ is positive.
hypotheses_covered: every choice sequence of length $N$ halts
